## Summary

Implements ADR 0156 benchmark campaigns with immutable plans, exact model/fixture identity, deterministic sequential scheduling, explicit Preparing-to-Running measurement boundaries, bounded pre-measurement infrastructure retries, failure-preserving evidence, pause/resume drift checks, strict Download & Run preflight identity, and truthful aggregate reporting.

This correction also removes the accidental temporary `foo` file from the work branch and replaces the campaign module with the reviewed state-machine implementation.
